new_content.name: Trade Shop
new_content.how_to_obtain: Crafted: planks, wool, planks in the top row; planks, iron ingot, planks in the bottom row (any planks, any wool).
new_content.notes: Place on top of or beside a container.

new_content.name: Admin Trade Shop
new_content.notes: Same setup as the Trade Shop, intended for admins and map makers.

mechanics.title: Setting up a shop
mechanics.description: Place the Trade Shop against a container and the Shop Settings GUI opens. Set what is sold and the price (clicking a slot while holding an item copies it as the setting, otherwise a menu opens), optionally allow hoppers or disable the hologram. Then stock the container.

mechanics.title: Buying
mechanics.description: Click the shop to open it and take the sold item; hold Shift to move it straight to your inventory. Price and stock are shown in tooltips.

mechanics.title: Protection
mechanics.description: Checks the Common Protection API so a player needs access to the source container; works with claim mods that support it.

getting_started: Craft a Trade Shop, place it against a chest, and fill in the settings GUI.
editor_notes: Currency is whatever item the owner sets. An economy API is bundled but no economy mod was verified in the pack.
name: Universal Shops
summary: Adds a Trade Shop block that turns a chest or other container into a player shop with a set price and stock. It works server-side with a hologram display, so no client mod is needed.
